assumptions: LLM reasoning error identification can be formalized via search path limitations.
definition.falsification: Empirical tests showing no correlation between heuristic search path choices and blind spots.
definition.statement: LLM reasoning blind spots systematically correlate with heuristic search path limitations and can be navigated through explicit path expansion.
definition.uncertainty: Whether structural search analogies fully capture semantic reasoning blind spots in large language models.

convergence_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Whether structural search analogies fully capture semantic reasoning blind spots in large language models.
convergence_evidence.decision_rule: Compare the feasible next distinguishing test, expected uncertainty reduction and cost against the frozen stop rule. Budget exhaustion or administrative closure is not scientific resolution.

limits: Finite computational evidence does not establish a general theorem or natural-science discovery.
Closing an investigation is an administrative stop; its recorded scientific uncertainty remains.
Execution validity, measurement validity, model interpretation and replication are separate fields.
Token and monetary costs are unavailable unless a provider reports them; they are never inferred as zero.
